name: Zephaniah
description: Prophet living at the time of Divided Monarchy

points: The word of the Lord which came unto Zephaniah in the days of Josiah the son of Amon, king of Judah.

note.label: Zephaniah 1: The Great Day of the Lord Is Near

points: “The word of the Lord which came unto Zephaniah the son of Cushi”. Look that word up: the word Cushi is generally used in the Hebrew Bible to refer to a dark-skinned person of African descent. Now we know Zephaniah was not African; he was a Hebrew of the children of Israel. That’s letting you know he was black.

“In the days of Josiah the son of Amon, king of Judah.” Zephaniah lived during the time of the kings, before Babylon, and he was prophesying of things to come: during the time of Babylon, yes; Persia and Media, yes; Greece, yes; Rome, yes; America, yes.
